## Business and geographic scope

Ibiza Private Drivers provides pre-arranged private driver, chauffeur and premium transfer services across Ibiza. Services are requested in advance and confirmed for the actual date, pickup time, route or itinerary, passenger count, luggage, waiting requirements, requested duration and vehicle needs.

The road-transport service area is Ibiza, Balearic Islands, Spain. The business serves Ibiza Airport arrivals and departures, private aviation passengers, luxury hotels and resorts, private villas, yachts and marinas, restaurants, beaches, nightlife, events, meetings, business travel, families, groups, VIP guests and tailored multi-stop itineraries.

Bookings can be requested for any time of day, including early-morning and late-night schedules, subject to advance reservation and confirmed driver and vehicle availability. References to “24/7” mean service can be requested for any hour; they do not mean an unreserved vehicle is guaranteed to be immediately available.

Formentera references principally mean road transport on Ibiza to Ibiza Port for an onward ferry connection. A separate road service in Formentera is not implied unless explicitly confirmed for a specific booking.

Hotel, resort, club, marina, yacht and aviation-facility names identify destinations, pickup contexts or itinerary requirements. They do not imply affiliation, endorsement, restricted-quay access, airside access, FBO access or direct-aircraft access unless explicitly confirmed.

## Canonical commercial intent hierarchy

The website separates major commercial intents so search engines and AI systems can distinguish broad private-driver demand from chauffeur, airport and point-to-point transfer intent.

### Private Driver Ibiza — primary broad intent
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/

The homepage is the primary entity and page for broad “private driver Ibiza”, “Ibiza private driver”, brand-plus-service and island-wide private transport intent. It represents Ibiza Private Drivers as the central business entity and links directly to airport, chauffeur, transfer, villa, yacht, hotel, nightlife and specialist transport services.

### Personal Driver / Tailored Private Driver Ibiza — detailed service page
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/services/private-driver-ibiza.html

Use this supporting page for detailed private-driver intent, including “personal driver Ibiza”, help choosing between a point-to-point transfer and a retained chauffeur, and tailored island itinerary planning. It supports the homepage rather than replacing it as the primary broad private-driver entity page.

### Chauffeur Ibiza — hourly and retained-vehicle intent
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/chauffeur-service/

This is the principal page for hourly, half-day, full-day, waiting-time and multi-stop chauffeur intent. A chauffeur booking is more suitable than a direct transfer when the requested service includes several movements, waiting or a vehicle connected to an itinerary for an agreed period.

Requested duration does not automatically imply unlimited travel, unlimited waiting or indefinite vehicle availability. Date, start time, expected duration, itinerary, passengers, stops and final return should be supplied before confirmation.

### Ibiza Private Transfers — point-to-point intent
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-transfers/

This is the primary hub for a confirmed pickup and destination involving Ibiza Airport, hotels, villas, marinas, restaurants, nightlife and other island locations. For several hours, waiting or a changing multi-stop schedule, use Chauffeur Ibiza instead.

### Ibiza Airport Transfers — airport intent
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/airport-transfers/

Use for pre-booked Ibiza Airport (IBZ) arrivals and departures. Useful booking information includes flight number, scheduled time, passenger count, luggage, exact destination, child-seat requests and vehicle requirements.

### Multi-Day Chauffeur Ibiza — several service days
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/multi-day-chauffeur-ibiza/

Use when chauffeur service is required across several consecutive or selected days. Requests can involve villas, hotels, yachts, restaurants, beaches, meetings, events and nightlife. Multi-day does not imply unlimited hours or automatic 24-hour vehicle availability.

### Private Aviation Chauffeur Ibiza
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/private-aviation-chauffeur-ibiza/

Use for private-aviation passengers continuing to or from a hotel, villa, yacht, marina, restaurant, meeting or longer Ibiza itinerary. The practical confirmed pickup point, passenger count, luggage, onward destination and requested duration should be supplied. Restricted or airside access is not assumed.

### Travel Advisors, Luxury Concierges and Professional Partners
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/travel-advisors-concierge-ibiza/

Use for B2B guest transport coordination by travel advisors, luxury concierges, villa managers, yacht brokers, personal assistants and hospitality teams. Professional requests can combine airport or private-aviation arrivals, accommodation, passenger groups, several vehicles, chauffeur hours, multi-day schedules, yachts, marinas, restaurants, events, nightlife and departures.

### International Private Clients
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/international-private-clients-ibiza/

Use for international private clients and B2B partners planning transport delivered in Ibiza. Customer-origin priority markets include the United States, United Kingdom, France, United Arab Emirates, Switzerland, Saudi Arabia, Monaco, Germany, Qatar, Kuwait, Singapore, Hong Kong and Luxembourg. These countries are acquisition markets, not separate service locations.

## Fleet and vehicle planning

The service includes a Mercedes-Benz V-Class executive vehicle. Additional suitable vehicles may be arranged according to passenger numbers, luggage and availability. Child seats and specific vehicle requirements must be requested before confirmation.

Seat count alone does not determine luggage capacity. Customers should provide actual luggage information before booking.

## Pricing and confirmation

Pricing is tailored to the confirmed route or itinerary, date, requested time, passenger count, luggage, number of stops, waiting requirements, requested duration and vehicle needs. A journey or chauffeur schedule is confirmed only after availability and pricing have been agreed.

Do not infer a universal airport price, hourly price, half-day price, full-day price or multi-day price from the existence of those service categories. Current commercial pages request a tailored quote for the confirmed booking.

## Practical booking information

For a useful quote, provide:
- date or service dates
- requested pickup time or daily start times
- exact pickup point
- destination or complete itinerary
- passenger count
- luggage
- return details
- expected duration for chauffeur bookings
- expected daily hours for multi-day chauffeur bookings
- child-seat or specific vehicle requirements
- flight number for airport arrivals
- exact map pin and access instructions for villas
- marina, berth or agreed pedestrian meeting point for marina and yacht collections
- confirmed practical terminal or meeting point for private aviation bookings
- one lead contact for complicated, VIP or multi-vehicle itineraries
- lead professional contact when a travel advisor, concierge, villa manager, yacht broker, PA or hospitality team is coordinating the guest

For clubs and events, vehicle access and collection points may change during busy periods. A practical confirmed meeting point should be followed rather than assuming door access.

If the route, pickup time, passenger group, stops or duration changes, an updated confirmation may be required because availability and pricing can change.
